name: RTS,S for pilot comparison areas CEA - based on SMC model
summary: Brings the RTS,S malaria vaccine to areas that served as comparison areas in the pilot, in countries including Malawi. GiveWell's spreadsheet "RTS,S for pilot comparison areas CEA - based on SMC model", linked from its grant page. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.
